messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was able to keep my head above water but with the force of the current unable to stand.

output.original_text: I was able to keep my head above water but with the force of the current unable to stand.
output.joy: I was thrilled to keep my head above water, even though the current tried to push me down!
output.sadness: I managed to keep my head above water, but it felt so heavy with the current dragging me under.
output.fear: I barely kept my head above water, the force of the current threatening to swallow me whole.
output.anger: I kept my head above water, but the relentless current made it impossible to stand—it’s so frustrating!
output.surprise: I was surprised to keep my head above water, though the current was much stronger than I expected!
output.disgust: I could only keep my head above water, and the current was just disgusting in how it tried to drag me down.
